info.title: synclabs/sync-3
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "synclabs/sync-3", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description:
The Sync Labs lipsync generation fields, shared by the v1 `POST /proxy/synclabs/v2/generate` request body and the Comfy Router input schema for `synclabs/sync-3`. See the note above this component for why the two surfaces share properties but not `required`.
`required` here is the ROUTER-SAFE floor: `model` is absent from it because Router writes the path's model into the body after routervalidate.Guard has already validated the caller's bytes. The v1 wrapper `SyncLabsGenerateRequest` re-adds it.

input.description: Input items; exactly one visual input (video or image) and one audio or text input

model.description: Name of the model to use for generation; only sync-3 is supported. On the Comfy Router route `POST /v2/models/synclabs/{model}` this field is supplied from the path and may be omitted.

outputFileName.description: Base filename for the generated output without extension

projectId.description: Optionally attach this generation to a Sync Labs project

segments.description: Segment definitions applying different audio inputs to different video segments

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL for generation status updates

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `synclabs/sync-3`: the terminal `GET /proxy/synclabs/v2/generate/{id}` document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished generation (`status: COMPLETED`) rather than the handle the submit returns.
The lipsynced video is at `outputUrl`, and its length in seconds at `outputDuration` — the field the per-second rate is metered from. A generation that fails carries `status: FAILED` or `status: REJECTED` with `error` and `errorCode` instead, and Router answers those as a failure rather than as a result. Two neighbouring URL fields are NOT the generation: `segmentOutputUrl` is a per-segment render and `synthesizedAudioUrl` is the audio synthesized from a text (TTS) input, so a document carrying either of those and no `outputUrl` is a success with nothing to collect and Router does not return it as one.
Router does not re-host these assets onto Comfy storage; `outputUrl` is Sync Labs' own link and expires on their schedule.

auto_detect.description: Whether to automatically detect and apply generation to the active speaker

bounding_boxes.description: Per-frame array of bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the detected face

bounding_boxes_url.description: URL to a JSON file containing bounding boxes

coordinates.description: Pixel coordinates [x, y] in the source video frame identified by frame_number

frame_number.description: Frame index that corresponds to the provided coordinates for manual speaker selection

SyncLabsDubParams.description: Dubbing parameters attached to a Sync Labs generate request

numSpeakers.description: Number of speakers in the source video; 0 enables auto-detection

providerName.description: Provider to use for dubbing (e.g. elevenlabs)

sourceLang.description: Source language code; defaults to auto

createdAt.description: The date and time the generation was created

error.description: The error message if the generation failed

errorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code if the generation failed

input.description: The input items used for generation

model.description: The name of the model used for generation

outputDuration.description: The duration of the output media in seconds

outputFileName.description: The sanitized filename applied to the output media

outputUrl.description: The URL of the output media

projectId.description: The id of the project this generation is attached to

segmentOutputUrl.description: The URL of the segment output media

status.description: The status of the generation (PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED, REJECTED)

synthesizedAudioUrl.description: The URL of the audio synthesized from a text (TTS) input

webhookUrl.description: The URL to the webhook endpoint

SyncLabsGenerationInput.description:
An input item for a Sync Labs generation. type is one of video, image,
audio, or text. Video/image/audio inputs are provided by url or
assetId; text inputs carry a TTS provider configuration.

assetId.description: ID of an asset from the Sync Labs media library

refId.description: Reference identifier used to link this input to segment definitions

segments_frames.description: Deprecated - use the top-level segments array instead

segments_secs.description: Deprecated - use the top-level segments array instead

type.description: Input type (video, image, audio, or text)

url.description: URL of the media to be used for generation

SyncLabsGenerationOptions.description: Additional options available for a Sync Labs generation

model_mode.description: Edit region for the model (lips, face, head); only works with react-1

occlusion_detection_enabled.description: Whether to detect occlusion during generation

prompt.description: Emotion prompt; only works with react-1

sync_mode.description: How to handle duration mismatches between video and audio (bounce, loop, cut_off, silence, remap)

temperature.description: How expressive lipsync can be, 0 to 1

SyncLabsGenerationSegment.description: Defines a video segment with its corresponding audio input

SyncLabsSegmentAudioInput.description: Audio input configuration for a specific segment

endTime.description: Optional end time in seconds to crop the referenced audio

refId.description: Reference ID of the audio/text-to-speech input to use for this segment

startTime.description: Optional start time in seconds to crop the referenced audio

SyncLabsSegmentOptionsOverride.description: Override generation options for a specific segment

occlusion_detection_enabled.description: Override occlusion detection for this segment

sync_mode.description: Override the sync mode for this segment

SyncLabsTTSProvider.description: Text-to-speech provider configuration for a Sync Labs text input

script.description: Script to be used for generation

similarityBoost.description: How closely the AI should adhere to the original voice

stability.description: Voice stability; lower values introduce broader emotional range

voiceId.description: Sync voice id (cloned voice from the Studio) or ElevenLabs voice ID
